label: BloggingPro Job Board
terms_note: Public WordPress RSS (bot-walled today); apply per posting.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (RSS, 403 to curl today). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Bot wall on the feed; no terms read. - Public WordPress RSS (bot-walled today); apply per posting.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published; the HTML/feed paths sit behind a browser check, the REST route answered plain requests on 2026-09-25. One request per second.
adapter.terms: Listings are BloggingPro's; many are syndicated from ProBlogger (meta._application points to the ProBlogger posting). Apply through the listing's own link.

search_postings.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager 'job_listing' post type exposed through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page ≤ 100, search, and the job-categories / job-types taxonomy filters, as listed by the route's own schema at https://www.bloggingpro.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings (OPTIONS)). `query` is WordPress full-text `search`; `category` is a job-categories TERM ID (GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-categories lists them) — not a slug. min_budget is not sent (salary is free text in meta._job_salary). title/description are rendered HTML; buyer is meta._company_name, deadline meta._job_expires (often absent); the apply link (meta._application) and location stay in raw.meta. Only published, public listings are returned.

get_posting.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> (the numeric post id from search_postings). An unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id.

not_offered.me: Anonymous read-only REST access; there is no account to verify without a WordPress login, which the board does not offer to API clients.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application endpoint: each listing carries an external apply URL or e-mail (meta._application); candidates apply there.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging in the REST routes (posts, taxonomies and media only).
not_offered.send_message: No messaging in the REST routes (posts, taxonomies and media only).
not_offered.credits: Free to read; no account, credit or balance endpoint.
